review: FF-3 statement-fidelity review v0.1 (lifted rosette-address to Ford-circle map)
reviewer: independent fidelity reviewer subagent, Claude Opus, spawned by skeleton 2026-11-04
scope: Meaning only: each of the 37 frozen statements read with the definitions it uses (FF-3 data v0.2 and inherited FF-1), against WORK_ORDER_v0_2.md. No Lean was run; compilation, axioms and replay are the auditor's separate step. No network; no file outside FIDELITY_REVIEW_v0_1 written.

mechanical_findings.private_helpers_note: All eight are `private theorem` (not exported); each is an auxiliary arithmetic/order fact (normalization of a/q, gcd nonzero, product-one cancellation, numerator bounds, bounded Bezout, mediant denominator bound, bounded successor in F_B). None introduces a public claim, an axiom, or Lemma 6a content.
mechanical_findings.lemma_6a: Not imported, not named, no axiom/sorry/opaque/native_decide token in any delivered source; P5 (iii) is proved from bounded Bezout plus the interval denominator bound inside the Sweep module. Lemma 6a is a markdown candidate, not a Lean module.
mechanical_findings.arcs_and_inversion: No statement constructs arcs, parameterizes arcs, or recovers an address from a phasor value; the only phasor-to-address statement is the M3 non-descent example.

computational_evidence.label: finite evidence, not proof
computational_evidence.note: Phase statements ([float] rows) reduce the rational address mod 2 exactly and then use floating-point sin/cos with tolerance 1e-12 (1e-9 for the parity identity); all other rows are exact BigInt rationals with Lean semantics.

targets.name: phasor_real_iff
targets.scope_note: Im(r*e^{i*pi*a}) = 0 iff a in Z, with r != 0 explicit; hn3 present but not needed for truth (order domain has 0 < n3).

targets.name: integer_spin_phase_iff
targets.scope_note: s : Z cast to Q; a in Z iff x in Z. The further link x in Z iff n3 | t2*s is integer_address_integral_iff.

targets.name: integer_spin_parity
targets.scope_note: (-1 : C)^(t1*s) is zpow with integer exponent; negative exponents give the same sign. Stated only under s : Z, as the order requires.

targets.name: circleMap_amplitude_independent
targets.scope_note: True by definition (circleMap reads only fordAddress t2 s n3); this is the intended content: Phi is a function of (t2, s, n3), independent of r and of t1 (t1 left unconstrained).

targets.name: phasor_alias_not_address_alias
targets.scope_note: M3 example exactly: t1 = t2 = 1, n3 = 3, s = 0 and s = 3 give equal phasors (phase addresses 0 and 2) and Ford addresses 0 and 1. Does not claim any general non-descent theorem, only the example, as the order does.

targets.name: integer_address_iff
targets.scope_note: den(t2*s/n3) = 1 iff (n3 : Z) | t2*s, for t2, s : Z, 0 < n3.

targets.name: integer_address_integral_iff
targets.scope_note: Same as P1 with IsIntegral (exists k : Z, x = k).
targets.work_order_locator: §4 P1; §3 a in Z <=> x in Z <=> n3 | t2 s

targets.name: integer_address_radius
targets.scope_note: Integer address has F1 radius 1/(2*1^2) = 1/2 in R.

targets.name: divisor_recovery_window
targets.scope_note: Reference case t1 = t2 = 1, s : N with s > 0; window filter over Icc 1 M equals Nat.divisors s ∩ Icc 1 M.

targets.name: zero_spin_address
targets.scope_note: s = 0 gives address 0 with denominator 1 for every t2 and 0 < n3.
targets.work_order_locator: §4 P1, the case s = 0 is separate

targets.name: zero_spin_window
targets.scope_note: Every n3 in [1, M] is a contact at s = 0 (whereas Nat.divisors 0 = ∅, which is why s = 0 is kept separate).
targets.work_order_locator: §4 P1, the case s = 0 is separate

targets.name: reduced_det_mul
targets.scope_note: det is FF-1 det on reduced num/den of rawValue a q = a/q; multiplication form |det|*g(a,q)*g(c,r) = |a r - c q| for a, c : Z, 0 < q, r.

targets.name: reduced_det_quotient
targets.scope_note: Uses Lean Z `/` (Euclidean division). Safe: divisor g(a,q)*g(c,r) >= 1 and reduced_det_mul shows the division is exact, so it equals the rational quotient. Stated as a corollary after the multiplication form, as the order requires.
targets.work_order_locator: §4 conventions (multiplication form first, quotient corollary); P2

targets.name: row_law
targets.scope_note: s : N, 0 < N, s < N (order: 0 <= s < N); right side N.

targets.name: row_tangent_iff
targets.scope_note: fareyAdj iff N = g(s,N)*g(s+1,N) in N.

targets.name: signed_column_law
targets.scope_note: Right side |u| for every u : Z (M2 fix). Quantifying over all u : Z is the same set as u = t2*s.

targets.name: signed_column_tangent_iff
targets.scope_note: fareyAdj iff |u| = g(u,n)*g(u,n+1).

targets.name: zero_column_stall
targets.scope_note: u = 0: equal addresses, det 0, not fareyAdj.

targets.name: reference_column_tangent_iff
targets.scope_note: Reference case t2 = 1, s > 0 (s : N): fareyAdj(s/n, s/(n+1)) iff s | n(n+1).

targets.name: unit_fraction_spine
targets.scope_note: rawValue 1 n = unitFrac n (definitional) and 1/n, 1/(n+1) adjacent for n >= 1.

targets.name: shell_contact_parameterization
targets.scope_note: t1 = t2 = 1, N >= 2, rational s in [0, N]: phase address integral iff s = mN/(N-1), m <= N-1 (N-1 is safe Nat subtraction since N >= 2). Guards s >= 0 and s <= N are needed (negative control NC6).

targets.name: shell_phasor_contact_iff
targets.scope_note: Same with the phasor itself and r != 0 (guard needed: negative control NC5).

targets.name: shell_contact_address
targets.scope_note: Ford address of the m-th event is m/(N-1).

targets.name: mem_shellEvents
targets.scope_note: Ties the parameterized Finset shellEvents to the order's event condition (2 <= N <= B+1, 0 <= s <= N, phase address integral). Guard 1 <= B is not needed for truth (B = 0 gives empty on both sides); it matches the order's shell base with at least one shell.

targets.name: mem_fareySet
targets.scope_note: fareySet B = {x : 0 <= x <= 1, den x <= B} = standard F_B. Guard 1 <= B unnecessary but harmless (B = 0 empty on both sides).

targets.name: shell_addresses_eq_farey
targets.scope_note: Finset equality, so deduplicated; the raw 860-event count at B = 40 is not claimed to be Farey (reviewer script: 860 events, 491 addresses = |F_40|).

targets.name: fareyList_membership
targets.scope_note: fareyList B = sort of fareySet B has the same members.

targets.name: fareyList_strict
targets.scope_note: List.Pairwise (<): strictly increasing.

targets.name: farey_consecutive_det
targets.scope_note: For consecutive x = a/b < y = c/d (reduced num/den): b*c - a*d = 1, the signed form (stronger than |det| = 1). hk0 is implied by hk1; harmless.

targets.name: det_zero_iff_address_equal
targets.scope_note: det x y = 0 iff x = y (reduced num/den); grounds "stall = determinant 0".

targets.name: classify_stall_iff
targets.scope_note: stall iff equal addresses.

targets.name: classify_tangent_iff
targets.scope_note: tangent iff fareyAdj (classifyEdge tests |det| = 1 after excluding equality; fareyAdj x x is false).

targets.name: classify_break_iff
targets.scope_note: EdgeKind.gap is the order's "break"; IsBreak carries the label |det| >= 2, so this theorem proves every non-tangent, non-stall edge has |det| >= 2.

targets.name: path_edge_trichotomy
targets.scope_note: Edges indexed by k : Fin m joining circles castSucc k and succ k of x : Fin (m+1) -> Q; exactly one of tangent / stall / break (one disjunction plus three pairwise exclusions).
targets.work_order_locator: §4 P6 "exactly one"; §5 edges and circles indexed separately

targets.name: path_kind_tangent_iff
targets.scope_note: Per-edge tangent classification on paths; only the per-edge condition is used, no mutual adjacency of three circles.

targets.name: tangent_endpoint_certificate
targets.scope_note: On a tangent edge the certificate is some (kissQ u v) in RatPlane = Q x Q and boundaryCheckQ holds on both circles (via inherited adjacent_kissQ).

targets.name: nontangent_no_certificate
targets.scope_note: No certificate on stall or break edges.

definitions.name: LiftedData
definitions.note: Record (t1 t2 : Z, s : Q, n3 : N, 0 < n3, r : R, r != 0) as in §3. Fields hn3, hr are used only through circleMap_amplitude_independent; other targets take unbundled arguments with explicit guards.

definitions.name: IsIntegral
definitions.note: exists k : Z, x = k. Shadows Mathlib root IsIntegral only by name: inside namespace FVLT.PhasorFordV1 the local name is meant, and Mathlib's IsIntegral takes a ring type as its first explicit argument, so IsIntegral (q : Q) could not elaborate to it. Even IsIntegral Z (x : Q) would be equivalent (Z is integrally closed). No meaning change. Advisory only: a downstream file that opens this namespace may see an ambiguity.

definitions.name: phasorValue
definitions.note: z1 = (r : C) * exp((pi * a : R) * I), §3 z1 = r e^{i pi a}.

definitions.name: liftedPhasor
definitions.note: phasorValue on a LiftedData record. Not used by any target statement (no inverse/recovery claim made with it).

definitions.name: circleMap
definitions.note: FF-1 boundary(fordAddress) = {z : |z - centre x| = radius x}, centre x + i/(2q^2), radius 1/(2q^2), q = reduced den; §3 Phi = C(x). Depends only on (t2, s, n3).

definitions.name: integerContactWindow
definitions.note: {N in [1, M] : den(s/N) = 1}, reference t2 = 1 (§4 P1).

definitions.name: divisorWindow
definitions.note: Nat.divisors s ∩ [1, M] (§4 P1 Div(s) ∩ [1, M]).

definitions.name: fareySet
definitions.note: m/q, 1 <= q <= B, 0 <= m <= q, gcd(m,q) = 1; = F_B (characterized by mem_fareySet). v0.2 binder (m : N) is the meant type.

definitions.name: shellEvents
definitions.note: (N, mN/(N-1)), 2 <= N <= B+1, 0 <= m < N; pairs keep events of different shells distinct (860 at B = 40, as in the order's raw count). v0.2 binder (m : N).

definitions.name: shellEventAddresses
definitions.note: Image of (N, s) -> s/N, deduplicated Finset (§4 P5 (ii)).

definitions.name: EdgeKind
definitions.note: tangent / stall / gap; "gap" names the order's "break" (tied by classify_break_iff to IsBreak). Naming difference only.

definitions.name: IsBreak
definitions.note: x != y and not fareyAdj and 2 <= |det|. The third conjunct is implied by the first two; including it makes the order's label part of the predicate, and classify_break_iff proves it holds for every gap edge.

definitions.name: classifyEdge
definitions.note: stall if x = y, else tangent if |det| = 1, else gap (§4 P6).

definitions.name: pathEdgeKind
definitions.note: Edge k : Fin m joins x (castSucc k) and x (succ k), x : Fin (m+1) -> Q (§5 indexing).

definitions.name: endpointCertificate
definitions.note: some (kissQ u v) iff |det u v| = 1 (= fareyAdj, definitionally), else none; exact rational RatPlane. No arc data (§5).

advisories: IsIntegral shadows Mathlib's root IsIntegral by name only; no meaning change (see definition row). A rename would be a definition change under the freeze rules; not requested.

Unneeded but harmless guards: hn3 in phasor_real_iff / integer_spin_parity / phasor_alias (order domain has 0 < n3); 1 <= B in the Sweep membership statements (B = 0 is the empty case); hk0 in farey_consecutive_det (implied by hk1). None makes a statement vacuous: every guard set is satisfiable and matches the order's domain.
EdgeKind.gap is the order's "break"; a prose note in any later write-up should say so.
liftedPhasor is defined but not used by any target; it carries no claim.
overall_result: PASS: all 37 targets MATCH and all 19 definitions MATCH WORK_ORDER_v0_2 §3-§6 (with M1-M4). Meaning review only; final FF-3 PASS also needs the auditor's independent rebuild, named-axiom report and strict replay.
